neighbours.label: postposed corrective 'more like' closing a short fragment ('Painful, more like.'); only the strongest trigger found on a broad pole
fire: They called it a short walk. A forced march, more like.
He says the soup was spicy. Volcanic, more like.
The advert promised a cosy cottage. A damp shed, more like.
My cousin calls himself careful. Stingy, more like.
People said the exam was tricky. Impossible, more like.
The guide described the road as bumpy. A riverbed, more like.
She told us the dog was lively. A hurricane, more like.
The manager called it a small delay. A disaster, more like.
quiet: They called it a short walk. It felt more like a forced march.
He says the soup was spicy. It is more likely that he added too much pepper.
The advert promised a cosy cottage. A damp shed was what we found.
My cousin calls himself careful. He would like more people to agree.
People said the exam was tricky. Impossible is the word I would use.
The guide described the road as bumpy. A riverbed would have been smoother.
She told us the dog was lively. A hurricane has done less damage.
The manager called it a small delay. A disaster followed a week later.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (1.3% of tokens reach 0.1 of max); top examples mix 'in length', 'more like.', 'any other', Korean 'including'/'like' and 'type 1 or type 2'. Probes: 'X, more like.' 0.76 and 1.18; 'in length' 0.17-0.24, 'or any other' 0.13-0.29, 'such as'/'like nursing'/'and the like' under 0.10, 'more like a trial' 0.16. I tested exemplification words as the shared pattern and it did not hold, so this label covers one strong context and will be partial at best.
